name: Post Haste
summary: A night-shift sorting game: read each parcel label and fling it into the right city sack before the clock
about: A full sorting office page with pigeonhole walls, an intake chute, a moving belt, hanging mail sacks and a station clock that doubles as your shift timer, watched over by a cat whose eyes follow the parcels. Boxes, envelopes and bubble mailers ride the belt with city labels; you send each one to Lahore, Karachi, Quetta or Peshawar before it drops off the end. Later shifts bring express parcels, return-to-sender stamps, code-only labels and sacks that swap places.
how: A demo shift runs on load; press Clock in, an arrow key or any sack to start your own.
Arrow keys (left, down, up, right), 1 to 4 or A S D F send the highlighted parcel to that sack; you can also tap a sack.
Parcels with a red RETURN stamp go in the return cart: press Space or tap the cart.
Meet the shift quota before the clock runs out; a wrong sack costs 2 seconds and a dropped parcel costs 1.
Five correct in a row raise the combo multiplier; P or Escape pauses and R restarts.
Your best score is kept on this device, and reduced motion stops the belt and bounce effects.
